description: This is an HTML file that implements a web-based user interface for visualizing database contents. It includes embedded CSS styles for layout and styling, and JavaScript code for dynamic interactions such as fetching database lists, tables, and data, as well as rendering and expanding table cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays an HTML table with data and handles wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cells, including handling objects, long text, and null values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing cell content for long strings and objects.
